raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.5.8"

package:
  name: pyreadr
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/p/pyreadr/pyreadr-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 07b5fa220283332775e9bcca7444222815bfc2dc0d6e762179553298ff50d73e

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: win
      then: set DISTUTILS_USE_SDK=1
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
    # uses m2w64 toolchain on windows, see conda_build_config.yaml
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - if: win
      then: conda-gcc-specs
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - cython
    - setuptools
    - if: win
      then: distutils-activate-mingw
    - bzip2
    - zlib
    - liblzma-devel
  run:
    - python
    - narwhals >=2.10.1

tests:
  # pyreadr requires pandas or polars at import time
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pandas
        - pip
    script:
      - python -c "import pyreadr"
      - pip check

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ofajardo/pyreadr
  license: AGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: read and write R RData and Rds files into pandas or polars data frames
  description: |
    Python package to read and write R RData and Rds files into/from pandas or polars dataframes. No R or other external dependencies required.
  documentation: https://github.com/ofajardo/pyreadr
  repository: https://github.com/ofajardo/pyreadr

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ofajardo
